summary: Canadian Solar Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing that its subsidiary Recurrent Energy secured $695 million in project financing and tax equity for the 330 MW Cobalt Solar facility in Riverside County, California. The package included approximately $484 million in debt financing led by MUFG and Nord/LB, plus a $211 million tax equity investment from Wells Fargo. The project is under construction with Blattner Energy as EPC provider and expected commercial operation by end of 2027. This is routine project financing, not a special situation, so no deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
